title.instructions: A few words naming the task. No leading verb, no repo name.

branchName.instructions: Use <type>/<short-slug> where type is feat, fix, chore, docs or refactor, lowercase, hyphens only.

commitMessage.instructions: Conventional Commits: type(scope): what and why. One line only. No body, no trailers, no Co-Authored-By, no attribution of any kind.
